findings.text: main() prints EXIT=<code> but never calls sys.exit, so the process always exits 0 and the sbatch wrapper's EXIT= line reads 0 even after an assertion or CLI failure, as fold-064016.log shows with EXIT=1 followed by EXIT=0.

the tests line carries the unsubstituted placeholder cd <worktree> and lists --phase census-before and --phase assemble, neither present in the cited logs, so the gate receipt promotion derives from it names a command that never ran.

snapshot() re-implements the nodes, sources and reviews graph reads that live_records() already provides at scc-momentum-tip-run.py:59 in the sibling instrument this file already imports, rather than extending that owner.

the module docstring names phases --pre, --preview, --apply, --post, --census and --control, which are not the implemented --phase values (pre, unblock-preview, unblock, baseline, preview, apply, post, census-before, census-after, control, assemble), so the reproduction note misleads a reader re-running it.

the node applied sn remove-lineage to clear an unbacked successor edge, a signed write the plan's section 4 ruling does not authorise; it is disclosed for coordinator ratification and reversing it restores the edge that blocks the fold.

the prose "one edge before the fold, none between the fold and the write" inverts the recorded order, since the lineage removal preceded the fold and checks.json records loser_incoming_successors_before as the empty set at the baseline reading.
